title: Falsification Paths (Architecture Pattern)
description: An architecture pattern: every alarm/alert in the system gets a FALSIFICATION PATH — a cheap, fast probe that tests whether the alarm is real — wired BEFORE the expensive ritual (page, rollback, escalation). Pattern structure: alarm → falsify (cheap) → if real, ritual; if false, log the learning. The pattern’s effect: alert fatigue cured structurally — most alarms falsify cheaply. For monitoring, ops, and incident systems. A Signature pattern by Justin Addam Higgins. Conceptual framework only.
worked_example: A falsification-path layer cut pages 70%: cheap probes falsified most alerts before human escalation.
